how.title: How to vote
how.signin.title: Sign in to AFC
how.signin.body: Use your AFC account, or make one. Every vote belongs to an account, so each person counts once.
how.uid.title: Link your Free Fire UID
how.uid.body: Add your Free Fire UID once. One UID, one account: a UID can only be linked to a single AFC account.
how.pick.title: Pick your creators
how.pick.body: One pick per award. Change it as often as you like until voting closes. Share a nominee's page to bring their fans in.
steps.title: From list to stage
steps.sub: Five steps from the first list to the trophy. Garena signs off twice, and nothing goes public before Garena has seen it.
steps.s1.title: Categories and lists
steps.s1.body: {count, plural, one {One award} other {# awards}}, each with a list of creators and every account link.
steps.s2.title: Garena checks
steps.s2.body: Garena reviews the accounts and approves the nominees: add, remove or swap names.
steps.s3.title: Community vote
steps.s3.body: You vote here on AFC, signed in, once per account.
steps.s4.title: The count
steps.s4.body: The numbers, your votes and a blind panel are combined. Garena confirms each winner.
steps.s5.title: The night
steps.s5.body: Winners revealed live at Detty Royale Showdown, the trophy handed over on stage.

trophy.c1.body: The real outline, patterned in eight bands, between two gold horns.

trophy.c2.body: On a gold plinth. About 40 cm tall.

decided.title: How a winner is decided
decided.sub: Three parts, then Garena's word. Ties go to the panel, then the numbers.
decided.numbers.title: The numbers
decided.numbers.body: What the audience does on each creator's posts, counted per view so size alone does not win.
decided.votes.title: Your votes
decided.votes.body: The community vote on this page.
decided.panel.title: The panel
decided.panel.body: Five judges who never know each other. Garena can name seats.
decided.then.title: Then Garena
decided.then.body: Every winner goes to Garena before the night: confirm, or overrule with a reason that is recorded. Nothing is announced before it.
night.title: The night
night.sub: The winners are revealed live at Detty Royale Showdown. Each nominee's film plays on the big screen just before their award is named.
faq.title: Questions
faq.who.a: Anyone with an AFC account. Making an account is free.
faq.whoUid.a: Anyone with an AFC account and a Free Fire UID linked to it. Making an account is free.
faq.howMany.q: How many votes do I get?
faq.howMany.a: One pick in each award. Each account has one ballot.
faq.change.a: Yes, as often as you like until voting closes. Only your last pick counts.
faq.winning.q: Can I see who is winning?
faq.winning.a: No. This page does not show vote counts, so an early lead does not decide the rest of the vote.
faq.whyUid.q: Why do you need my Free Fire UID?
faq.whyUid.a: So one player counts once. Your UID is never shown on the page.
